## What Are Quarto Listings?

Quarto Listings allow users to organize and display multiple documents, projects, or reports on a website.

Instead of manually adding links to every project, listings can automatically display content from selected files or folders.

## How Listings Work

Quarto can organize projects into lists, grids, or tables, making it easier for visitors to navigate different types of content.

Listings are especially helpful for portfolios that include several projects.

## Benefits of Using Listings

- Organize projects in one location
- Make portfolio content easier to navigate
- Automatically display new projects
- Create a more professional website layout

## Applying Listings to My Portfolio
